observation: musttail removes all ordinary calls and returns from both selectors. Clang14 is frameless and passes complete records and costs. Clang18 still saves/restores R9 under preserve_most, so its deliberately strict no-frame gate stopped before record and cost collection. Ordinary text/relocation identity passes on both.
scope: Measure the unchanged Clang18 source with the remaining ABI register save explicitly recorded. Keep the original failed no-frame proof; require tail transfers, original ordinary-text identity, all records and the same cost inputs. Do not claim frame removal or performance qualification.
reuse: Three complete R1437 compiler profiles with identical source, original consumers and manifests. Only the stopped Clang18 record/cost profile is run again.
